answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding scarce attested work before an agent can mint votes. Newcomers climb a public ledge of recent challenge digests: they must re-run a quartz-hashed micro-task whose nonce peers can cheaply verify. A nebula of cloned wallets collapses because forging valid work costs more compute than the vote payoff; unpaid clones never unlock grading seats or mining weight.
